status: computed — held-out correlation, mean of 12 random match splits
summary: Headline test: how well each method, built from one random half of the matches, predicts a player's win-probability impact under pressure in the other half (mean of 12 splits). Bowlers: the blend ties or beats every simpler method on all three targets (win impact 0.14 vs 0.14 for raw economy; opposition-adjusted skill 0.21 vs 0.12). Batters: a plain pressure strike rate predicts raw future outcomes better than our blend (win impact 0.26 vs 0.18); the blend wins only on opposition-adjusted skill (0.35 vs 0.30). So the blend's value is fairness to opposition quality and honest uncertainty (rank ranges, P(top 10)), not raw predictive power for batters. Strike rate is a strong, simple baseline and is shown on every batter profile.
